old_summary: Python API does not validate output_format; unknown values become PDF
v3_evidence: The Python API accepted output_format='jpg' and output_format='PNG' even though the documented choices are png, pdf, and svg. Empty input failed as FileNotFoundError and 'banana' failed in Matplotlib, not in pathview's API validation.

old_summary: map_null=False does not remove unmapped rows when a data table exists
v3_evidence: With map_null=False and one matched gene, plot_data_gene still had 27 rows while only 1 row carried a value.

old_summary: min_nnodes counts pathway layout nodes, not nodes matched by input data
v3_evidence: One completely unmatched input ID with min_nnodes=1 returned a truthy result with 64 layout nodes and plot_data_gene=None.

old_summary: pathway prefixes that conflict with species are concatenated, not rejected
v3_evidence: pathview('mmu00020', species='hsa') looked for hsammu00020.xml and raised PathwayNotFoundError rather than rejecting the conflicting prefix.

old_summary: negative experiment count is silently accepted
duplicate KGML entry IDs silently overwrite earlier entries
v3_evidence: Two KGML entries with id='1' parsed successfully and the second entry overwrote the first.

old_summary: line graphics coords are ignored and replaced with zero/default geometry
v3_evidence: A KGML line with coords='10,20,30,40' parsed with x=None, y=None, width=46, height=17.

old_summary: Bezier control <point> children inside SBGN <next> are discarded
v3_evidence: Nested SBGN control points (20,20) and (25,20) were omitted; only start, next, and end coordinates remained.

old_summary: bbox_inches='tight' crops/rescales native output instead of preserving KEGG pixels
v3_evidence: A 120x100 native background saved as a 792x664 output with title, key, and signature disabled at dpi=100.

old_summary: graph/PDF renderer uses only the first experiment color
v3_evidence: Graph rendering reduced two colors per node to one node_color entry per node.

old_summary: unknown routing mode silently falls back to straight
v3_evidence: route_edge_spline(..., routing_mode='banana') returned a finite (30,2) curve rather than rejecting the mode.

old_summary: invalid KEGG file types fail with internal KeyError instead of validation error
KEGG downloader trusts any HTTP 200 body without format/content validation
v3_evidence: A mocked HTTP 200 HTML body for a PNG was written to hsa00020.png and reported as succeed. XML now has a content check, so this is a partial fix only.

old_summary: KEGG chemical conversion uses alias 'cpd' where API specifies 'compound'
v3_evidence: The generated KEGG conversion URL still used /conv/cpd/ rather than /conv/compound/.

old_summary: already-prefixed compound IDs receive a duplicate source prefix

v3_evidence: Uppercase Reactome/PANTHER IDs resolved, while lowercase forms returned null.

old_summary: all-transparent SVG nodes are forcibly recolored gray
v3_evidence: render_node_svg replaced a transparent fill with the theme's unmapped color.

old_summary: Reactome SBGN file exporter route is coded as /exporter/sbgn/{id}.sbgn instead of /exporter/event/{id}.sbgn
_add_symbol_labels joins a SYMBOL column but never replaces the rendered label
v3_evidence: _symbol_labels returned an empty label map for a gene whose existing label was the Entrez text '7157'.
